notes: Scope: Sabha Parva §§VII–IX, Narada’s descriptions of the celestial assemblies of Indra, Yama, and Varuṇa. This batch does not repeat the §X–XI rosters in mb_sabha_people.json.

Only individually named people/deities are included. Places, personified abstractions, generic divine classes, unnamed queens/attendants, personified rivers, and large unnamed groups (including the many same-named kings) are excluded.

Repeated or ambiguous names are scoped by passage and occurrence: two Sāvarṇis in §VII, repeated §VIII names (including Nala, Gaya, Pratardana, Ariṣṭanemi, Sudyumna), two Rāmas in §VIII distinguished by patronymic, distinct Nāga/royal/Asura namesakes, and two Bali mentions in §IX are not merged.

The text directly states Yama is Vivasvat’s son, the Daśarathi Rāma is Daśaratha’s son, and the other Rāma is Jamadagnya’s son. The Jamadagnya patronymic remains a separate source-scoped node rather than a cross-roster identity inference.
